entry.identity.pending.text: External sign-in is coming soon. Use your CHAOS account below.

entry.gate.intro.text: Enter the system. Your next move changes the map.

entry.gate.session.text: Your session stays active after closing the app. Sign out on shared devices.

entry.gate.tagline.text:
Real places.
Real players.
Real consequences.

entry.gate.tools_desc.text: Build your setup. Hack, trade, communicate.

entry.gate.world_desc.text: Real world map. Live data. Real players.

entry.description.text: Cyber Hacking Adventure Of Senses. Enter the operator desktop, choose a target, run your tools and let the map reveal its data.

entry.launch.stale.text: This session is no longer current. Log in again.

entry.launch.storage.text: Allow session storage to start CHAOS safely.

entry.install.optional.text: Installation is optional. Your existing account terms still apply. An installed app may require a separate login.

entry.install.manual.text: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen. If unavailable, use a browser supporting PWA installation.

entry.install.ios.text: On iPhone or iPad, open CHAOS in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen. You may need to sign in again in the installed app.

entry.install.ready.text: Installation is available. Click “Install on this device” — no need to search the browser menu.

entry.install.cancelled.text: Installation cancelled. You can try again later.

entry.install.accepted.text: Request accepted. Waiting for installation confirmation.

entry.install.unavailable.text: Native installation is unavailable here. See the platform instructions.

entry.install.shortcut.text: Download Linux shortcut (not a PWA installation)

entry.install.update.text: Update ready. Finish your operations and close all CHAOS windows; reopen CHAOS to apply it.

entry.install.error.text: Installation could not start. Use the browser menu.

entry.install.android.text: On Android, open https://chaos.re directly in a regular Chrome tab. If “Install on this device” appears, use it. If neither this button nor a browser installation option is available, installation is not currently offered in this tab. You can keep playing in the browser. Browsers, including DuckDuckGo, do not all offer the same installation flow.
